glossary.title: Plain-language glossary (translation needed)
glossary.intro: This glossary is not yet translated to Русский. Contributions welcome at docs/principles/ru.md.

yourCallingCard.explain: A short page where you tell others what SDG you care about, what you can offer, and what you need.

spark.explain: A small action — like a save or a thumbs up — that tells us you might want to learn more about someone.

companion.explain: Someone you and they have both agreed to connect with.

kindred.explain: We compare what you wrote about yourself with what others wrote, to suggest people who think and care about similar things.

mustHave.explain: Rules that decide who you definitely won't be matched with — for example, you must share at least one common language.

fairnessBoost.explain: We give a small extra visibility to people whose voices are usually missed — for example, those working in least-developed countries — so the network does not just amplify the already-loud.

yourSpace.explain: Your data is stored separately from every other organisation. No one in another organisation can ever see it.

privacyLine.explain: A rule built into our database so that even our own code cannot accidentally show someone else's data.

changeRecord.explain: Whenever something important changes, we write down who changed it and when, so you can always check the history.

privacyMask.explain: Before AI reads your text, we hide personal details like names, phone numbers, and addresses.
